parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~26232~~) operation to query the ID of the primary instance.

parameters.name: GuardDBInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the disaster recovery instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~26232~~) operation to query the ID of the disaster recovery instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds receive-db-instance --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk500000 --guard-db-instance-id rm-tr2whku00000 --region cn-hangzhou
